description: This file contains a PHP class 'Latest' in the namespace Opencart\Admin\Controller\Extension\Opencart\Module that manages the 'Latest' module within the OpenCart admin extension. It includes methods for displaying and saving module configurations, handling user permissions, and rendering the module's admin interface.

classes.name: Latest
classes.description: Controller class for managing the 'Latest' module in the OpenCart admin extensions, handling configuration view and save operations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the module configuration page, setting up breadcrumbs, loading language resources, retrieving module info if editing, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the POST request to save or update the module configuration, checks permissions, validates input, updates the database, clears cache, and returns JSON response.
